description: Read the status of watchlist monitors created with create_watchlist_monitor. With exactly one id, the target is re-screened against the latest lists right now (and its webhook fires if the status changed); with 2-20 ids, the stored statuses from the last 6-hourly re-screen are returned without re-screening. Use one id when you need a fresh answer before acting and several ids for a periodic sweep; for a name or wallet without a monitor use screen_entity or screen_wallet, and to stop monitoring use cancel_watchlist_monitor. Unknown ids are reported as not found. Costs $0.001 USDC for one id or $0.002 for 2-20 ids via x402 on Base; unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired result and failed calls are not charged.

monitor_ids.description: 1-20 monitor ids (MON- followed by 22 URL-safe characters). One id = live re-screen; 2-20 ids = stored statuses.

name: check_watchlist_monitors

lists_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) each screening list was last updated, keyed by list (e.g. us_ofac_sdn, eu_consolidated); check it before relying on a clear result

notFound.description: Several ids: ids that do not exist

requested.description: Several ids: number of valid ids requested

results.description: Several ids: id, type, value, label, status, lastCheckedAt, expiresAt

subscription.description: One id: id, type, value, status clear|review|alerted|expired|cancelled, previousStatus, matches, lastCheckedAt, expiresAt, webhookDelivery

anyOf.description: Returned with isError=true when payment is needed: sign one of `accepts` with an x402 client and repeat the call with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

accepts.description: Accepted payment options: scheme 'exact', network 'eip155:8453' (Base), USDC asset, amount in 6-decimal atomic units, payTo address

error.description: Why payment is required, or why the submitted payment was rejected

extensions.description: x402 protocol extensions (e.g. bazaar discovery metadata)

resource.description: The paid resource: url, description, mimeType

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired

title: Check Watchlist Monitor Statuses
